entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Perfect timing. You've got a guest.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Sorry to bother you this early in the[n]morning.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I was wondering if you'd like this.[n]There's no obligation, of course.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You've helped me through a lot.[n]I wanted to express my appreciation.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Sorry for how this is coming off.[n]I didn't mean for it to seem like I'm[n]just dumping my leftovers on you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I'm the one who should be thanking[n]you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well, look at this hotshot. Lucky guy,[n]having a gorgeous lady drop by this[n]early just to give you treats.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I hope you don't mind that I stopped[n]by today. No doubt you already got[n]some from someone special?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Oh... Uh, sorry, did I say something wrong?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Um... I'm sure you have nothing to[n]worry about in that department.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: How about we stop right there, lady.[n]For his sake.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I should really be going, anyway.[n]Sorry to impose.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: And this is hardly the end of my debt,[n]of course. Chocolate isn't going to[n]cover all you've done for me.
